The Dragon King (2026) | Full Fantasy Movie in 4K

Fifteen years in chains could not break her. But her twin brother — the King who rules the black sea dragons with a crown made from their mother's horns — has taken her young dragon son.

At sunset tomorrow he will give the young dragon fire from those horns. Then the little dragon will belong to him forever — and so will every dragon in the sky.

To save him, Ilva must walk alone into the Hall of Horns. Her son Aren, raised by the man responsible for his father's fall, must choose between the crown and the brother he was trained to pursue. And Lumi, the pink dragon with his mother's eyes, will risk everything for both of them.

She came alone. She will not leave the same.
